justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/PackageDescription.java (183 lines): it is a small interface with only two behavior methods (`contains`, `isDefault`), one shared abstract base, and two concrete nested implementations (`Simple`, `ForLoadedPackage`) that all model the same package concept. The tests in byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/PackageDescriptionSimpleTest.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/AbstractPackageDescriptionTest.java cover only package-name, annotations, default-package, and containment behavior. The file reads as a cohesive package abstraction rather than an insufficiently modularized class.
